name: USBComposite
description: CDC-ACM + vendor-class composite USB device for STM32. Replaces the stm32duino USBDevice library so the firmware keeps one virtual COM port (Serial/MAVLink) while exposing the config protocol on a WebUSB-claimable vendor interface. Requires lib_ignore = USBDevice.
keywords: usb, cdc, webusb, winusb, stm32, composite
